estimates: The exterior includes the museum entrance and the hotel wing that contains it. The exhibits, other DomAquarée blocks, bridge carriageway and aquarium are outside the scope.
The seven storeys and basement are mapped. Minor walls, materials, window bays, roof sections and museum entrance joinery are approximated from written records and mapped controls.
The city’s source terrain sets the lower promenade and terrace. The precise slender retaining edge along the façade needs bounded rendering clearance to show the lower entrance.

review.notes: Reviewed exact Qualla media before looking at external sources. No photographs were adopted for the exterior. Written primary sources and mapped footprint and entrance geometry control the model.
